spec.description:
supaBATT is a high-density, rigid glasswool external wall
insulation board engineered specifically to enhance the thermal performance of
brick veneer walls in response to NCC 2022 7-star energy efficiency standards.
Available unfaced or pre-faced with a Class 4 vapour-permeable membrane
(supaBATT VP4), it is installed externally onto timber or steel studs before
brickwork is laid. By insulating over the exterior face of framing, it
eliminates thermal bridging, controls moisture vapour transfer, and boosts total
wall system R-values.

install:
Fix
supaBATT boards horizontally or vertically to the outside face of timber or
steel stud framing

Secure boards mechanically with approved insulation
fixings or brick tie brackets into framing

For supaBATT VP4, ensure the
vapour-permeable membrane faces outward towards the brick cavity

Overlap the
integrated membrane flap of upper rows over lower rows and tape with 3M Seaming
Tape / VapaSeam Tape

Where unfaced supaBATT is used, butt boards tightly
together and install an approved external wall wrap over the face

Tape and
seal all cuts, penetrations, and corners to maintain air and water barrier
integrity

Fasten brick ties through supaBATT into structural studs,
maintaining required cavity clearance to brickwork
selection_checklist:
Confirm brick veneer cavity width accommodates supaBATT thickness while
maintaining 40-50mm masonry air cavity

Choose between supaBATT plain
(requires separate wrap) or supaBATT VP4 (integrated Class 4 wrap)

Verify
required R-value to achieve 7-star NatHERS rating in conjunction with internal
wall batts
Order compatible face-mount brick ties and seaming tape
limitations:
Must be installed on
external face of stud framing behind masonry or cladding with a drained cavity

Cladding/brickwork should be installed without prolonged delay to prevent
weather damage

Must not be compressed into internal stud bays designed for
soft batts

retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher supaBATT is a rigid, high-density glasswool board designed for
installation onto the exterior face of timber or steel studs in brick veneer
construction. Engineered to help builders achieve 7-star NatHERS energy
compliance under NCC 2022, it provides continuous external insulation that
eliminates stud thermal bridging. Available plain or factory-laminated with a
Class 4 vapour-permeable membrane (supaBATT VP4), it combines non-combustible
bulk thermal resistance (AS 1530.1) with condensation management, backed by a
Consumer Lifetime Warranty.
